others.route: Work permit (Office of the Prime Minister)

note: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: a non-national's work permit is applied for at the Office of the Prime Minister and approved by Cabinet, on its own for six months at most, with a residence permit beyond; fees run by 30, 60 and 90 days. OECS nationals need neither since 1 August 2011 (the oecs list); CARICOM's skilled nationals come on the Skills Certificate (the csme list). No days without a permit.

sources.title: St Vincent and the Grenadines Consulate, Work Permit (requirements and fees as of 1 March 2016)
sources.said: Complete Work Permit Application Form (in duplicate) along with the following and ... Return Application Form to the Office of the Prime Minister (Work Permit Department): ... As of August 1, 2011 under the OECS Treaty, OECS Nationals are not required to ... submit work and residence applications ... A work permit ONLY is issued on a one-time basis for not more than six (6) months.
